"skill To view the printable edition, click the link provided. Then fill the Sudoku grid with the digits 1 through 9, making sure each number appears only once in every row, column and 3×3 block.

Think of the puzzle as a temporary challenge, much like a short‑term gas leak that must be contained before it spreads, requiring you to concentrate on each cell’s correct placement, akin to monitoring climate shifts.

Adding a twist to the usual routine, the Observer’s next digital edition will reveal the completed solution, giving you a chance to compare your work.

The satisfaction of solving it carries a certain weight, rewarding the effort with a sense of accomplishment akin to balancing a scale."
